skill.name: social-media-calendar
skill.description: Create a 30-day social media content calendar from a topic, with platform adaptations and posting time suggestions.
skill.summary: Plan a month of platform-ready social media posts from one topic.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The only static finding was a high-entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Review showed the file is readable Markdown with Chinese text and no encoded payloads, binary content, scripts, network access, or prompt-injection instructions.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.21 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable Markdown; the line 1 finding points to front matter and the file content is normal Chinese text, not binary or encrypted data. No obfuscated payloads, commands, or encoded blocks appear in the reviewed file.

content.value_statement: Social media planning can become inconsistent when teams start from a blank page. This skill turns one topic into a 30-day calendar with platform guidance and posting time suggestions.
actual_capabilities: Creates a 30-day social media content plan from a supplied topic.
Adapts content ideas for different social media platforms.
Suggests publishing times for planned posts.
Supports use in Claude Code, Codex, and similar AI assistants.
Prompts users to review important AI-generated outputs manually.
limitations: It provides planning guidance, not automatic publishing or account management.
It does not include scripts, API integrations, analytics imports, or scheduler connections.
Posting time suggestions are general and should be checked against audience data.
Critical campaigns still need human review before publishing.

use_cases.title: Launch a Content Month
use_cases.description: Plan daily posts for a campaign, product launch, or seasonal topic.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Planning
use_cases.description: Create a first draft calendar that can be refined for each client platform.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Team Publishing
use_cases.description: Give team members a shared posting plan with topics, formats, and suggested timing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-day social media calendar for [topic]. Include post themes, platforms, and suggested posting times.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt for Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 30-day calendar for [topic] across Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok. Adapt each idea to the platform.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Campaign Month
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-day launch calendar for [product or event]. Balance education, trust building, engagement, and promotion.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for a Team Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-day social calendar for [topic]. Include owner roles, review checkpoints, platform adaptations, and timing assumptions.

output_examples.input: Topic: sustainable meal prep for busy professionals.
output_examples.output: Week one focuses on awareness and simple habits. Monday uses a LinkedIn tip post at 9:00, while Friday uses an Instagram carousel at 12:00.

output_examples.input: Campaign: new accounting service for small businesses.
output_examples.output: The calendar starts with pain-point education, adds proof posts in week two, and ends with consultation prompts on LinkedIn and Facebook.

output_examples.input: Need a calendar for a freelance designer.
output_examples.output: The plan mixes portfolio posts, process notes, client education, and availability reminders with suggested weekday publishing windows.

best_practices: Provide a clear topic, audience, platforms, and campaign goal.
Review each post idea for brand voice, legal claims, and local timing.
Use performance data to adjust suggested posting times after publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not publish AI-generated copy without checking factual and brand details.
Do not ask for one generic calendar across every platform without audience context.
Do not treat suggested posting times as analytics-backed guarantees.

faq.question: Does this skill publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates planning guidance and suggested timing. It does not connect to social accounts.

faq.question: Which platforms can it plan for?
faq.answer: The skill supports platform adaptation in prompts. Specify the platforms you use for better results.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: Does it replace a social media manager?
faq.answer: No. It helps create first drafts, but strategy, review, and approval stay with people.

faq.question: How much campaign detail should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide audience, offer, platforms, tone, dates, and any topics to avoid.

faq.question: Are the posting times guaranteed to perform well?
faq.answer: No. Treat them as starting points and adjust with analytics from your accounts.
